subject: Re: Closing cadence & stepwise credits for AWS marketplace offer
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@bluefinretail.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Eval window & target close for marketplace offer

Hi Vanessa / Ben,

Thanks again for the product walkthrough yesterday. Bluefin's pilot team is ready to run a 6-week evaluation focused on search relevance and cost-per-inference. Procurement has asked for a clear path to a marketplace private offer (AWS) that ties discounts to evaluation milestones so we can justify the incremental spend to finance.

Can you share an evaluation plan with milestone deliverables and a suggested credit/commit schedule (we prefer stepwise credits tied to go/no-go gates)? Also, what does a canonical timeline to GA purchase look like if all gates pass (approx close date and list of artifacts procurement needs)?

Best,
Samantha
Samantha Lee
Head of ML Platforms, Bluefin Retail
Attachments: none
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@bluefinretail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-29T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Eval window & target close for marketplace offer

Samantha — thanks for the clear ask. I pulled together a concise evaluation plan that maps milestones to credits and a proposed AWS private-offer cadence. High level:

- Week 0–1: Environment & onboarding (access, S3/KMS verification, baseline tests) — small onboarding credit to cover ramp.
- Week 2–3: Relevance evaluation (prompt suite, A/B tests, quality metrics) — second tranche of credits released if quality delta meets threshold.
- Week 4–5: Scale & latency (load tests, cost targets) — final evaluation tranche and performance signoff.
- Week 6: Executive review + procurement approval -> request private offer and sign.

I attached the evaluation-plan.xlsx with milestone acceptance criteria and suggested credit amounts tied to each gate. For the commercial path, Ben and Karthik have a suggested pricing ladder (PDF attached by Ben) that reduces per-token price as commit ramps, with a contract signature step for the AWS private offer.

Next steps: please confirm the acceptance thresholds in the spreadsheet and procurement timing; if agreeable we can draft an SOW and initiate a private offer with AWS (we typically need a 21-day lead time for marketplace provisioning and legal sign-off).

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
phone: +1-415-555-0129
Attachments: evaluation-plan.xlsx (Excel, 4 tabs)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@bluefinretail.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-30T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Eval window & target close for marketplace offer

Following up with the pricing ladder I referenced — attached. Key points:

- Entry tier (evaluation): temporary credit pool to cover pilot consumption (applied in AWS private offer as upfront credit).
- Ramp tiers: 3-step per-token discount ladder tied to committed monthly units (e.g., 0–100M tokens, 100–500M, 500M+).
- Early-conversion kicker: if Bluefin converts to a 12-month reserved commit within 30 days of eval sign-off, we apply a one-time conversion credit equal to 10% of the remaining evaluation credit.

I also included an example cadence: evaluation credit disbursements scheduled upon acceptance of the milestones in the spreadsheet; private-offer issuance after final signoff with DocuSign for commercial terms.

Ben Carter
Sales Director | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Attachments: pricing-ladder.pdf (2 pages)
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@bluefinretail.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Breuer <t.breuer@bluefinretail.com>, Bluefin Legal <legal@bluefinretail.com>
Date: 2027-04-01T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Eval window & target close for marketplace offer

Thanks — this is helpful. A few clarifications from my side / procurement: 

- Procurement prefers the credits show up in the AWS private offer as explicit line-items (start-of-eval credit, mid-eval credit, final-eval credit) so finance can amortize.
- We need SOW language that limits data retention to our account, details KMS integration, and includes SOC2 evidence.
- Target close: if we start the eval the week of Apr 5 and hit all gates on time, procurement can sign the private offer around May 20. Can Redwood support that closing cadence (we need the AWS private offer active within 10 business days of signature)?

Also: Tom from procurement is on the thread for logistics.

— Samantha
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@bluefinretail.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-03T14:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Eval window & target close for marketplace offer

Samantha / team — we can accommodate the May 20ish close if we lock timelines now. Operational checklist and commitments from Redwood: 

- Legal & SOC2: I'll have our compliance lead prepare a SOC2 evidence bundle and a short data flow addendum for the SOW within 3 business days.
- Marketplace lead time: AWS private-offer provisioning typically completes in 7–10 business days after DocuSign-executed commercial terms; we can push for 5–7 if we prioritize it.
- Credit structure: we will present the credits as line items in the AWS private offer and mark them as non-refundable pilot credits that will be applied on invoice.
- POC support: Dedicated solutions-engineer time during weeks 1–3 (included in evaluation credit).

I've attached a draft SOW for your review; it includes the KMS and retention language you requested. If Bluefin signs off on the evaluation acceptance criteria by Apr 6, we will queue the private-offer paperwork and aim to have the DocuSign envelope out by Apr 12.

Karthik
VP Sales | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Attachments: SOW-draft.docx (Word, 3 pages)
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>

- Redwood to finalize SOC2 evidence bundle and push SOW with agreed KMS language by Apr 9. (Karthik)
- DocuSign envelope for commercial terms and AWS private offer to be sent by Apr 12; our target for private-offer activation is May 21 assuming a May 20 signature. (Vanessa / Ben)
- Procurement ask to show credits as line items in the private offer: confirmed — credits will appear as explicit line items, with amounts and release conditions noted. (Ben)
